gameMod.name: Example Tools
gameMod.note: The in-game mod that registers these commands and events. Quests that use this pack need it installed on the player's machine — say so in the quest description.

events.name: ExampleTools.Breach.FileDownloaded
events.label: A file was downloaded from a breached machine
events.docs: Fires when the player saves a file out of a remote session on a machine they breached. Match the file by its path or name, or the machine by host or IP.

events.name: ExampleTools.Scan.Completed
events.label: A scan of a target finished
events.docs: Fires when the player's scan of a target completes. Match on the target that was scanned.

storage.label: Plant loot on a machine
storage.docs: Adds a file to the machine's remote session: when the player breaches the target, the file is there to find and download.

fields.label: Host or IP
fields.hint: The machine the loot waits on. A domain name works.

fields.label: File path
fields.hint: Where the file sits in the remote session, like /opt/case/evidence.txt.

fields.label: File contents
fields.hint: What the file says — this is where your clue goes.
